messages:
Maya: Kicked off the prefetch probe for the new int8 build (v1.2-int8) across us/eu/apac regions. Short summary: hit rate improved ~12% in EU, but p99 in APAC spiked on H100 with kernel fallback. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/bench/2081
Samir: Nice. artifacts? can you add brief config and seqlen mix?
Maya: Uploaded logs + csv to the artifact bucket, link in thread. Quick config: seq len mix = 8/32/128/512 weights [0.4,0.35,0.2,0.05], prefetch_window=16, pager_mode=off (pagerless prefetched KV), continuous_batching=on, batch_target=64.
Jin: Did you run cold vs warm KV starts separately? important for p50 vs p99.
Maya: Yes — 20% cold starts, 80% warm. Cold starts push p50 up but the big issue is eviction churn leading to kernel fallbacks in APAC H100 which affects p99. Example snippet from logs:
```
[2026-03-19T14:12:08Z] kernel_select: requested fastpath, loaded kernel v2
[2026-03-19T14:12:08Z] fallback: driver mismatch -> slowpath
p99 delta: +34ms
```
Aisha: Can you paste hit-rate vs p99 by region?
Maya: EU: hit 78% -> p99 210ms
US: hit 71% -> p99 230ms
APAC: hit 70% -> p99 290ms (observed fallbacks on H100 nodes)
Throughput (tokens/s per GPU): EU 570k, US 540k, APAC 510k
Lars: This is with continuous batching on and kernel autodetect? did we change any kernel flags for the probe?
Maya: autodetect (enable_dyn_kernels=true). We observed APAC default to older kernel due to driver/toolchain mismatch. Plan: try `force_kernel=fastpath` as a canary.
Samir: Any quality regressions with int8? we need to gate onboarding on evals.
Maya: Ran eval set (3k prompts). BLEU-like metric stable within +/-0.6% vs fp16. Small human spot-check (20 queries) — no obvious semantic regressions. Artifacts include eval_stats.csv.
benchbot: deploy-bot: artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-bench/2081234567/ : logs.tar.gz, charts.pdf, kv-hitrate.csv, seqlen_hist.json
Jin: Next steps I suggest: 1) run APAC with `force_kernel=fastpath` and prefetch_window=8 to see if eviction hit-rate changes and p99 drops; 2) run US with prefetch_window=32 to test throughput/hitrate tradeoff; 3) repeat cold-start heavy run (~60% cold) to see worst-case p99.
Maya: Agree. I'll queue the three runs and tag results here. Targeting EOD tomorrow for preliminary numbers. cc @Aisha for eval alignment.
Aisha: Added the runs + eval tasks to the onboarding tracker. Please include `sequence_length_histogram` and per-kernel fallback counts in the artifacts.
Samir: If `force_kernel` fixes p99 in APAC, we should consider a short-lived regional override while infra fixes the driver mismatch. :thumbsup:
Maya: Yep. Also noting: with pagerless prefetch, hit-rate is sensitive to sequence mix; recommend adding a traffic-profile lab test that skews to long sequences (512) to validate tail behavior before full rollout.
Lars: Good call. I'll coordinate infra to check the H100 toolchain versions in APAC tomorrow.
Maya: Thanks — will post results once runs finish.
